name: search_overflow
description: Search archived session content; return verbatim excerpts with paths and line numbers. For a recent original result, use order:'recent', kind:'evidence', match:'phrase' and text from that result.
first_use_guidance: Search only offloaded session content; scan every retained file fully. Evidence is a source tier, not verification: exclude recognized history checkpoint/summary prefixes; unmarked continuations may remain. Cross-root duplicate lines collapse after trim/whitespace normalization; raw totals stay unchanged. The footer reports shown/raw lines, shown/matching files, scanned files, active controls, duplicates and hidden lines. Complete answers keep a one-line footer. Truncation adds top files and up to two narrowing calls/edits; lower max_results if context was dropped. Zero kind hits: retry kind:'all'. Markers: >> phrase/regex, >t typed term, >b CJK fragment (verify full wording); two spaces = context. Long lines show ...; read_file gets full text/context. A miss means not found under these filters, not proof it never existed.

query.description: Nonempty search text, or one regex when is_regex:true.

order.description: Default relevance: score/fair-share ranking; tied line scores prefer later lines. recent: newest file mtime then latest line; equal mtimes use path order. recent ignores scores/reservations; matching and raw totals stay unchanged.

match.description: Default any: OR substrings plus CJK pairs (runs >=3; up to 24 sampled pairs); full coverage/phrase ranks higher. all: every distinct typed term on one line. phrase: untouched literal substring, no expansion; requires is_regex:false. Regex any/all use one pattern. Paths never switch modes automatically.

kind.description: Default all. evidence: raw tool snapshots, overflow-history.md, preserved user/image content. derived: folded groups, internal notes, summary-sources/, checkpoints. This labels storage sources, not verified truth.

scope.description: Default all: both scopes plus preserved user/image content. history: overflow-history.md + summary-sources/ (raw summary inputs). tool_outputs: tool snapshots, folded groups, internal notes and checkpoints.

file_pattern.description: Optional glob on archive-relative path, scope-root-relative path or filename; e.g. '*execute_command*' or '*internal-note-overflow*'.

is_regex.description: Default false. true uses query as one regex; case_sensitive applies unless regex inline flags override it.

case_sensitive.description: Default false (ignore case); true narrows to exact casing.

context_lines.description: Surrounding lines per match; default 2, range 0-5.

max_results.description: Matching lines across all files; default 50, range 1-200. Raising it raises the per-file ceiling.
